shortDescription: DCNM ansible module for managing service policies.

options.name: attach
options.description: a flag specifying if the given service policy is to be attached to the specified service node

options.name: config
options.description: a list of dictionaries containing service policy and switch information

options.name: deploy
options.description: a flag specifying if a service policy is to be deployed on the switches

options.name: fabric
options.description: name of the target fabric for service policy operations

options.name: service_fabric
options.description: name of the external fabric attached to the service node for service policy operations

options.name: state
options.description: the required state of the configuration after module completion.
